Y when either residue lies within 10 A of Glu148. Those rows are shaded. NOTE: proximity is not evidence of higher activity - the paper's own successful variants sat outside the second shell around the active site.

epiSCI ranks epistatic co-evolutionary support, NOT measured activity. All entries are DOUBLE mutants; the method does not score single mutations. In the paper, success was defined as a 1.03-fold or greater titer increase, and no correlation between SCI and measured activity is reported. Position L200 (mature L165) appears in 39 of the top 100 pairs, so the head of the list is dominated by one hub residue. Every candidate requires experimental validation.
Only 8% of the top 100 pairs are shared with an earlier 301-sequence run built by a different homolog-selection method, so the ranking depends heavily on MSA composition.
Of the PH20 positions reported as activity-enhancing in the patent literature (mature 69, 70, 271, 309, 324), this run recovers only 309, at rank 194.
